zero_isoline_source_accuracy: not inferred from quantization; independent data-owner probe required

policy.source_geometry: unmodified data/derived/land.geojson and lakes.geojson, exact straight source boundary segments
policy.source_sign: unmodified water-detail.u8 nearest pixel-centre class0 land, class1 ocean, class2 inland
policy.projection: mapping-v1, projected metres, source radius6371008.8m, standard parallel41deg
policy.exclude: artificial clipping segments lying exactly on the region rectangle boundary
policy.distance: Euclidean nearest source boundary segment in projected metres at canonical pixel centres, computed in float64 within3000m narrow band; outside band distance capped
policy.encoding: Two UInt8 channels: code=R*256+G; projected_distance_m=code*0.125-4096; positive water, negative land; narrow band capped at3000m
policy.filter: decode four nearest RG8 texels before scalar bilinear interpolation; zero-isoline derivative antialiasing; semantic water kind unchanged
policy.limitations: distance quantization bound is not a coastline position bound; zero-isoline offsets and protected small features require independent measured source-space review; no historical accuracy claim
